title: Qwen4Exp QSA raw-index key ring audit
scope: source and test audit; no runtime or GPU measurement

current_owner.raw_keys: FP32, one key per QSA layer and token, physically scattered through the paged attention block table
current_owner.pooled_keys: FP32 normalized/RoPE keys, one per complete compression block

memory_formula.note: The raw-key ring can save only the raw-key resident portion; pooled bank, member map, block starts, scores, selected buffers and attention KV remain.

raw_key_reads: restore_count only rewinds cursors; it does not read raw keys
consumer_audit.pooled_bank: incremental: prepare_complete_blocks returns when complete <= pooled_count and otherwise processes only new blocks
consumer_audit.snapshot_restore: current device transactions snapshot recurrent state and restore attention/index cursors by position; host QSA snapshot copies raw_keys[:count] for the standalone host reference state
consumer_audit.rollback: device rollback uses index.restore_count(position), which sets pooled_count=position//compression_ratio; MTP draft trim uses the same cursor contract
consumer_audit.dirty_destination: not covered by a dedicated raw-key-ring test
consumer_audit.partial_block_and_wrap: not covered by a ring implementation because no ring exists
consumer_audit.capacity_2051_2052: existing boundary gates cover dense/sparse selection behavior, not a ring representation
consumer_audit.c2: capacity planning and ownership gates exist, but no pooled-history ring admission exists

existing_evidence: tests/test_gpu_qwen4_exp_runner_qsa.py: incremental pooled block counts and restore_count cursor
tests/test_live_qwen4_exp_mtp_runner.py: target/MTP snapshot and restore paths

decision.reason: The ring is a memory-saving representation change, not a redundant-work cleanup. The raw-key owner has exact consumer locations and a bounded potential saving, but current device transactions restore only cursors and current tests do not cover partial-block leftovers, wrap, dirty destinations or pooled-history ownership under ring eviction. Implementing it requires a separate state/snapshot ABI and full exactness/capacity gate; no safe promotion follows from this audit.
decision.next_gate: If the 1.5 GiB raw-key saving at native 256K becomes binding, prototype a request-owned open-block-plus-verifier-width ring with pooled history authoritative, then test partial blocks, wrap, dirty destination, 2051/2052, rollback, c2 and full logits/KV/state equality.
